findings.evidence: The declaration at lines 227–231 has left side `fun x => Real.sqrt (gaussianPDFReal 0 1 x) • ...`; `rg "weightL2Isometry" Basis.lean` finds the operation only in documentation, while roadmap README.md:201–208 requires the relation obtained by applying `weightL2Isometry`.
findings.fix: Export an equality for the appropriately transported `weightL2Isometry … (gaussianHermiteHilbertBasis 𝕜 n)` itself, using the existing pointwise lemma as its proof.
findings.issue: `weightL2Isometry_gaussianHermiteHilbertBasis_apply` only states an a.e. equality for manually multiplying a representative by `√pdf`; it never mentions `weightL2Isometry`, so consumers cannot rewrite the isometry applied to the public basis (whose measure type also requires transport).

summary: The earlier naming issues are resolved, but the advertised Gaussian-basis isometry theorem still does not expose an equation involving the isometry itself.
